description: This Java source file defines a REST API endpoint for managing device credentials within the Hono framework. It implements HTTP handlers for CRUD operations related to device credentials, interacting with an event bus to process requests. The class extends an abstract HTTP endpoint, registers routes for GET and PUT methods, and coordinates request handling and responses.

classes.name: CredentialsManagementHttpEndpoint
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractHttpEndpoint, providing HTTP routes for managing device credentials via the event bus in the Hono framework.

methods.name: CredentialsManagementHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Vertx instance, ensuring it's non-null.

methods.description: Returns the event bus address used for credentials management messages.

methods.description: Returns the unique name of this endpoint, combining API version and endpoint identifier.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Registers REST routes for GET and PUT methods to fetch and update device credentials, including CORS and body handlers.

methods.name: updateCredentials
methods.description: Handles updating credentials for a device by constructing a message and sending it over the event bus.

methods.name: getCredentialsForDevice
methods.description: Handles retrieving credentials for a specific device by sending a GET message via the event bus.

methods.name: getCredentialsResponseHandler
methods.description: Creates a response handler to process the outcome of credential fetch/update operations, setting HTTP status and body accordingly.
